title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.
